ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white pixels, with white pixels concentrated on the distal outer lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large irregular white patches on the distal 30% of each lobe; left lobe contains a large white contiguous region with dark internal mottling; right lobe contains a white region with prominent dark linear diagonal striations; central peduncle transition is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with higher frequency and pixel-amplitude on the distal halves; a notable deep indentation is located on the right lobe edge approximately 80% from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep transitioning into a complex trailing edge with localized convex arcs between serration peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast textured pixel groups localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally and vertically across the white pigmented regions of both lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks across the ventral surface and significant barnacle encrustation on both fluke terminals.
